integration: Only the early affine entry point gains the image test. A nonzero modular image declines that zero proof; a zero or unavailable image invokes the unchanged exact coefficient reducer with its full previous budget. The V2 normal-form fallback and existing dyadic filter remain unchanged.
supported: Rational leaves; rational pi multiples as sine/cosine arguments; sqrt(2), sqrt(3), sqrt(6); arithmetic sums, products, squares, rational inverses, bounded binary scales and retained three-term linear combinations. At least one retained trig node is required.

proof: A finite image is defined only when all scalar and expression divisors are invertible modulo the selected prime and Phi_L(root)=0. Polynomial evaluation then preserves zero remainders. Nonzero images can decline zero proofs; zero images never certify zero. The ordinary checked exact reducer retains sole authority to certify zero. Production formal verification remains open.
